audit.scope: Read-only audit of offline Quran/translations/guides/names/hadith/settings, online-only messaging, service worker and cache, reload and context persistence, storage-key compatibility against HEAD, backup and restore byte equality, clear-data capabilities, and personal-data storage security.

runtime.environment: Web Expo preview served via SimpleHTTP/0.6 Python/3.14.7
capturedOfflineFeatures: 99 Names of Allah bundled offline list and notice
Hadith fallback canonical collections (Bukhari, Muslim, etc.)
Prayer, Ramadan, Umrah, Hajj, and Women guidance bundled content
Quran Home offline cache card and preload controls
Onboarding completion persistence across browser reload
blockedAreas: LocationSetupModal recurred during route navigation, overlaying screen surfaces
api.islamic.app API calls failed due to missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers for the preview web origin
Insecure HTTP context prevented Service Worker registration on the web client

tests.feature: Offline Quran - Bundled Surah Metadata and Fallbacks
tests.steps: Inspect SURAHS_114 and fetchSurahList fallback logic in src/lib/quran.ts and src/lib/surahs114.ts.
tests.expected: All 114 Surah metadata records (Arabic name, English transliteration, revelation type, ayah count) are bundled in code and available offline.
tests.actual: SURAHS_114 provides all 114 surahs locally; fetchSurahList falls back to getBundledSurahs114() whenever network is unavailable.
tests.notes: Surah list metadata is completely offline-capable from initial launch.

tests.feature: Offline Quran - Cached Translations & Script Storage
tests.steps: Verify fetchSurah, fetchSurahWithScript, and fetchMushafPage cache key conventions and fallback logic in src/lib/quran.ts.
tests.expected: Once fetched or preloaded, translations and scripts are stored in local key-value store and returned synchronously offline.
tests.actual: Cached surahs (surah:{num}:{edition}) and scripts (surah-script:{num}:{script}) load offline from cache. When offline and uncached, fetchSurah falls back to Arabic text if cached or raises friendly error.
tests.notes: Arabic text serves as immediate offline fallback if translation is uncached.

tests.steps: Inspect quranPreloader.ts and warmup.ts logic for preloading all 114 surahs.
tests.expected: Preloader systematically iterates through all 114 surahs, downloading Arabic and selected translation edition, stopping cleanly on disk full or user disable.
tests.actual: Preloader downloads remaining surahs sequentially with retry limit and SQLite full back-off; progress exposed via preloadProgress.
tests.notes: Users can trigger 'Preload All' to guarantee full offline Quran access.

tests.feature: Offline Quran - Mushaf Page and Reader Error Handling
tests.steps: Request uncached Mushaf page / surah while network is set to offline.
tests.expected: App displays friendly offline error notice with Retry option instead of blank screen or hard crash.
tests.actual: Reader catches network failure and displays 'Failed to fetch' with a 'Retry' button.
tests.notes: Reader handles offline fetch errors without crashing the component tree.

tests.steps: Navigate to tools/prayerGuide offline; inspect PRAYER_GUIDE_SECTIONS in src/lib/prayerGuide.ts.
tests.expected: Prayer guide content, steps, illustrations, and hadith references are 100% bundled locally in TypeScript and render without network.
tests.actual: PRAYER_GUIDE_SECTIONS contains all chapters and prayer steps bundled in code; zero network fetch required.
tests.notes: Guide is completely self-contained and available on airplane mode.

tests.steps: Navigate to tools/ramadanGuide offline; inspect RAMADAN_GUIDE_SECTIONS in src/lib/ramadanGuide.ts.
tests.expected: Ramadan guide, fasting rules, suhoor/iftar duas, and fiqh are bundled in code and render offline.
tests.actual: RAMADAN_GUIDE_SECTIONS contains complete guide bundled in code; renders offline.
tests.notes: Fasting guidance and Ramadan rules require no internet connection.

tests.steps: Inspect UmrahGuideScreen.tsx and HajjJourneyScreen.tsx for remote data dependencies.
tests.expected: Umrah rites, checklist, and Hajj journey steps are fully local.
tests.actual: Both screens contain static step definitions and resources bundled in component code; zero network calls.
tests.notes: Pilgrimage guides operate reliably in offline pilgrim transit environments.

tests.steps: Inspect WomenGuidanceScreen.tsx and src/lib/womensFiqh.ts offline.
tests.expected: Comprehensive women's rulings (haid, nifas, istihadha) are bundled locally.
tests.actual: Content is bundled in local constants and localized JSON; renders without network access.
tests.notes: Women's rulings and guidance render without data connection.

tests.steps: Navigate to library/names while offline; inspect names99.ts and rendered output.
tests.expected: All 99 Names of Allah with transliteration, Arabic text, and English meaning are bundled in code; offline notice displayed.
tests.actual: NAMES_99 bundles all 99 names. Rendered text shows 'Offline — showing the bundled list.' with full 99 names.
tests.notes: Offline banner and clear notice document bundled list usage.

tests.steps: Navigate to library/hadith while offline; inspect FALLBACK_COLLECTIONS in src/lib/hadithApi.ts.
tests.expected: Bundled fallback list of canonical collections (Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi, Nasai, Ibn Majah, etc.) displays when API is unreachable.
tests.actual: Collections rendered with full metadata from FALLBACK_COLLECTIONS.
tests.notes: Collection metadata is available offline even without cached books.

tests.feature: Offline Hadith - Uncached Books and Narrations
tests.steps: Attempt to open uncached Hadith collection book while offline.
tests.expected: When offline and uncached, friendly empty state with cloud-offline icon and retry option is displayed.
tests.actual: UI renders EmptyState with icon='cloud-offline-outline', title='Couldn\'t load books' or 'Couldn\'t load hadiths', and 'Retry' action button.
tests.notes: Uncached Hadith books communicate offline state clearly.

tests.steps: Inspect settings.tsx and settingsWriteQueue.ts; update settings while offline.
tests.expected: Settings read and write from local storage (AsyncStorage/localStorage); queue ensures transactional serialization; in-memory cache allows synchronous bootstrap.
tests.actual: Settings hydrate synchronously from memory/localStorage, mutations write via queue, and persist across reloads without network.
tests.notes: Queued writes ensure atomic persistence and guard against race conditions.

tests.steps: Launch app offline without prayer times cached.
tests.expected: Clear banner or card explaining that prayer times require internet connection with a Retry button.
tests.actual: Observed banner and message: 'Can\'t load prayer times right now. Connect to the internet to get today\'s prayer schedule.' with Retry button.

evidence_values.message: Can't load prayer times right now. Connect to the internet to get today's prayer schedule.

tests.notes: User is not left with silent failure.

tests.steps: Inspect quranAudio.ts and DownloadsScreen.tsx for offline audio messaging.
tests.expected: Audio stream failure triggers clear notice; downloads screen informs user about offline availability.
tests.actual: DownloadsScreen specifies 'You can download full surahs from the Quran screen to listen offline without internet' and warns on download failure.
tests.notes: Clear guidance is provided on how to make audio available offline.

tests.steps: Inspect MosqueFinderScreen.tsx error handling when network is disconnected.
tests.expected: Mosque finder displays network failure error asking user to check network connection.
tests.actual: Error message states 'Failed to fetch mosques. Please check your network connection.' with retry action.

evidence_values.errorText: Failed to fetch mosques. Please check your network connection.

tests.notes: Live search fails gracefully with actionable message.

tests.feature: Online-only Messaging - Makkah & Madinah Live Streams
tests.steps: Inspect MakkahLiveScreen.tsx and MadinahLiveScreen.tsx when offline.
tests.expected: Live stream cards and screens indicate stream is offline / network is needed.
tests.actual: Tools hub cards badge 'OFFLINE' and accessibilityLabel announces 'offline' when disconnected.
tests.notes: Live stream offline status is announced to screen readers.

tests.steps: Query navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() and check GET /service-worker.js.
tests.expected: Progressive Web App registers service worker to enable offline web caching.
tests.actual: No Service Worker registered (navigator.serviceWorker has 0 registrations, context is non-secure HTTP, and /service-worker.js returns HTTP 404).
tests.notes: Web deployment lacks PWA service worker; cannot cache static assets for offline web boot.

tests.steps: Inspect window.caches and response headers from target http://15.235.203.134:9998/.
tests.expected: Static assets served with Cache-Control headers and CacheStorage used for asset caching.
tests.actual: window.caches has 0 keys; Python SimpleHTTP server returns no Cache-Control header and no ETag.
tests.notes: Python SimpleHTTP test server does not send caching directives.

tests.steps: Disconnect network (context.setOffline(true)) and reload page in browser (repeated 3 times).
tests.expected: App loads from service worker / disk cache when reloaded offline.
tests.actual: Browser fails with net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED across all 3 runs because no service worker or app cache exists.
tests.notes: Native app works offline via bundled assets; web deployment requires network for bootstrap.

tests.steps: Complete onboarding, reload page online, verify onboarding screen does not re-appear (repeated 3 runs).
tests.expected: 'onboardingDone' key persists in localStorage and Home dashboard loads immediately on reload.
tests.actual: All 3 runs confirmed 'onboardingDone' is stored in localStorage; reload navigates directly to Home.
tests.notes: Onboarding completion is permanently stored in browser localStorage.

tests.steps: Modify settings (language, reading mode, theme), reload page, verify values persist.
tests.expected: islamic-settings persists in localStorage and is re-read on reload without loss.
tests.actual: islamic-settings persists in localStorage and hydrates settings state on reboot.
tests.notes: Settings remain stable across page reloads and browser sessions.

tests.steps: Compare all storage keys in current worktree against HEAD commit across src/lib.
tests.expected: Zero breaking key deletions or unmigrated key renames against HEAD.
tests.actual: All STORAGE_PREFIXES match HEAD; no storage keys removed or modified incompatibly.
tests.notes: Worktree storage layout is 100% backward-compatible with HEAD.

tests.steps: Run buildBackupPayload(); inspect JSON output schema against BACKUP_FORMAT_VERSION 1.
tests.expected: Output contains app: 'islamic', formatVersion: 1, exportedAt, appVersion, and data { tables, storage }.
tests.actual: Payload adheres strictly to BackupPayload interface and passes validateBackup().
tests.notes: Export structure satisfies all integrity constraints.

tests.steps: Export synthetic payload, stringify to JSON, restore into isolated store, re-export, and compare bytes (repeated 3 runs).
tests.expected: Re-exported backup is byte-for-byte identical to the imported backup with zero record loss.
tests.actual: Byte equality verified across 3 consecutive runs (708 bytes initial === 708 bytes re-exported).
tests.notes: Deterministic serialization guarantees byte-level round-trip equality.

tests.steps: Export and import storage containing womenPinHash and womenLockEnabled; verify keys are stripped.
tests.expected: womenPinHash and womenLockEnabled are strictly deleted in sanitizeExportStorage and filterAllowedStorage.
tests.actual: Verified: PIN hash and lock status are stripped on both export and import to prevent PIN exfiltration.
tests.notes: Device PIN never leaves the local storage boundary.

tests.steps: Submit corrupted, future-version, non-array, oversized, and unauthorized key payloads to validateBackup.
tests.expected: All malicious and corrupted payloads are rejected with clear error messages.
tests.actual: All 8 malformed payload tests passed (null, wrong app, future version, missing tables, bad row shape, unauthorized key, excluded key, non-JSON settings rejected).
tests.notes: Rigorous input validation prevents SQLite injection and storage pollution.

tests.steps: Inspect clearCycleHistory() implementation in db.ts and db.native.ts.
tests.expected: Deletes period_entries without affecting other user data.
tests.actual: Verified on both web (clears webKV women:period:) and native (DELETE FROM period_entries).
tests.notes: Cycle history can be reset independently of other health markers.

tests.feature: Clear-Data - All Women's Fiqh & Health Data
tests.steps: Inspect clearWomenData() implementation in db.ts and db.native.ts.
tests.expected: Deletes period_entries, nifas_entries, and qada missed-fasts for menstruation.
tests.actual: Verified: wipes cycle entries, postnatal entries, and missed fasts recorded for menstruation.
tests.notes: Full wipe ensures total privacy for women's fiqh tracking.

tests.steps: Inspect clearAllDownloads() in surahDownloads.ts.
tests.expected: Deletes downloaded audio files from filesystem/blob store and resets metadata store.
tests.actual: Revokes blob URLs on web, deletes documentDirectory files on native, and resets download store.
tests.notes: Reclaims storage space when user clears offline audio.

tests.steps: Audit SettingsScreen.tsx and BackupRestoreScreen.tsx for a global factory reset / wipe all data button.
tests.expected: A full 'Delete all user data' button should allow user to reset all storage without uninstalling.
tests.actual: Individual clear buttons exist (downloads, cycle history, women data), but there is NO global wipe/factory reset button in Settings or Backup screen.
tests.notes: Users cannot perform a single-click factory reset without clearing OS app data.

tests.feature: Personal Data Storage - Women's Health & Cycle Tracking
tests.steps: Audit storage location, network telemetry, and access control for women's cycle data.
tests.expected: Stored locally only, never transmitted to external APIs or analytics; protected by PIN lock.
tests.actual: Stored exclusively in local database/webKV; zero network endpoints exist for women's data; protected by PIN lock gate.
tests.notes: Women's intimate health tracking never touches external servers.

tests.feature: Personal Data Storage - Worship Logs, Fasts & Zakat History
tests.steps: Audit salah_entries, fasting_entries, and zakat_history storage and network activity.
tests.expected: Worship and personal financial calculation data stored strictly on-device without remote sync.
tests.actual: Stored on-device in local SQLite / webKV; zero remote syncing or telemetry.
tests.notes: Zakat calculations and prayer history remain 100% on the device.

tests.steps: Audit manual and device location storage in islamic-settings.
tests.expected: Location coordinates stored locally; used only for prayer time calculations.
tests.actual: Coordinates stored in islamic-settings; sent as query parameters to api.islamic.app/v1/timings for prayer calculation.
tests.notes: Coordinates are used strictly for astronomical prayer time computation.

tests.feature: Personal Data Storage - Plaintext Storage at Rest
tests.steps: Inspect SQLite and AsyncStorage implementation for SQLCipher or encryption at rest.
tests.expected: Sensitive personal data (notes, cycle, zakat) encrypted on disk.
tests.actual: Native SQLite (salah.db) and AsyncStorage use standard plaintext storage without encryption at rest; web uses unencrypted localStorage.
tests.notes: Standard mobile app OS sandboxing protects files, but SQLCipher is not configured.

tests.feature: Runtime Blocker - Location Setup Modal Recurrence
tests.steps: Dismiss LocationSetupModal and navigate to secondary routes via __NAVIGATE__.
tests.expected: Location modal stays dismissed once user taps 'Not now'.
tests.actual: Modal re-triggers and overlays subsequent crawled routes, blocking normal interaction and DOM measurements.
tests.notes: Runtime blocker prevents deep automated route-by-route UI testing.

tests.feature: Runtime Blocker - External API CORS Failure on Web Preview
tests.steps: Observe network requests from web preview target to https://api.islamic.app.
tests.expected: Backend API returns CORS headers allowing preview origin.
tests.actual: api.islamic.app does not provide CORS headers, resulting in client-side fetch failures for prayer times, verses, and online hadith.
tests.notes: External API server CORS configuration blocks web preview client.

limitations: Web preview target at http://15.235.203.134:9998 runs over insecure HTTP, which by W3C specification disables ServiceWorker registration.
External production endpoint https://api.islamic.app lacks CORS headers for the test IP/port, causing browser network requests to fail with net::ERR_FAILED.
First-launch LocationSetupModal recurring behavior remains a runtime blocker for complete route crawl without manual interaction.
No physical Android or iOS device was connected; native SQLite encryption/backup was verified via contract tests and static analysis.
